integrity: The claim is proved symbolically from the prime-factor formulas for \(\varphi\), \(\psi\), and \(\sigma\). The earliest verified public appearance of the focal paper is arXiv:2404.19332 on 2024-04-30; primary MSC 11A25 is verified from the journal record. No independence or external validation is claimed.
limitations: The theorem gives the sharp composite additive gap only for the cubic expression. It does not determine analogous sharp gaps for other powers or mixed expressions. The finite replay through \(300000\) is regression evidence, not an infinite proof.
title: Sharp composite gap in a cubic totient–Dedekind–divisor-sum inequality
